column3: NASB adds “with honor,” and “this one” in the second and third lines is rendered “that one … another.”
“Let him recount it to me” is rendered with NASB adding “Yes,” and “a people of antiquity” as “the ancient nation.”
“Be in dread” is rendered “tremble,” and NASB adds “I know of none.”
“A craftsman of iron a tool” is rendered “The man shapes iron into a cutting tool.”
“Marker” is rendered “red chalk,” and “scraping tools” as “planes.”
NASB follows the Qere “by Myself,” rendering “all alone.”
“Let it be refounded” is rendered “Your foundation will be laid.”
